verdict.rationale: Blaxel documents long-lived API keys and short-lived OAuth tokens that work across its APIs, CLI and SDK. It also offers time-limited, scoped session tokens for operating sandboxes, and label-based ACLs that give agents read or read-write access to specific Agent Drive paths. These are least-privilege mechanisms, but the evidence never shows that general API keys can be restricted to particular permissions or resources for an agent. Missing for 10: role- or permission-scoped API key issuance, documented per-agent credential scoping beyond sandbox sessions and Drive ACLs, independent or hands-on corroboration.
